contract.tax_note: All rates are nett, USD per room per night on double occupancy, and include breakfast, service charge and government taxes.
contract.child_policy_text: Infants are up to 4.99 years of age, while Children are between 5 and 11.99 years of age. Children age 12 years and above will be charged adult room and meal rates. Infant cots are provided free of charge and must be booked at the time of reservation. Third person child (05 years to 11.99): USD 30 per night (Extra Bed + Breakfast), nett incl. service charge and government taxes. Children (5y – 11.99 yrs) will be charged 50% of the adult meal supplements and of the all-inclusive supplement.
contract.cancellation_text: Cancellation and No Show Policy (as printed): 01 May 26 to 30 Jun 26 & 01 Sept 26 to 31 Oct 26 – Cancellations within 00-07 days prior to arrival will be charged 50% of room nights booked; within 07-14 days 25% of room nights booked. 01 Nov 26 to 19 Dec 26, 11 Jan 27 to 30 Apr 27, 01 July 27 to 31 Aug 27 – Cancellations within 00-07 days prior to arrival will be charged 100% room nights booked; within 07-21 days 50% of the room nights booked. 20 Dec 26 to 10 Jan 27 – Cancellation within 60 days prior to arrival will be charged 100% of the room nights booked. Note: No Show on arrival will be subject to the above charges as per the season. The resort retains the right to fully charge for early departures. [Nothing is printed for 01 May – 30 Jun 2027 and 01 Sep – 31 Oct 2027: the low-season row carries 2026 dates.]
contract.payment_text: Full Payment is required on or before the payment due date given by the hotel Reservations Department at the time of booking. Bookings over festive period (20 December to 10 January) will require 100% prepayment before 01 October. Full payment excluding telegraphic transfer/bank charges is to be made to the following bank account details: LKR Payment Only – Bank of Ceylon, E.P.Z Branch- Koggala, SWIFT BCEYLKLX, Acc No. 7465296, La Forteresse (Pvt) Ltd; US$ Payment Only – Bank of Ceylon, Galle Super Grade, SWIFT BCEYLKLX, Acc No. 0084559016, La Forteresse (Pvt) Ltd. (On the printed page these payment lines are partly covered by a pasted image of the bank details; read from the PDF text.)
contract.voucher_note: Special offers MUST be clearly marked on all rooming lists/requests/accommodation vouchers (The Fortress).
contract.terms_text: RATE TABLE NOTES: Minimum 4 nights stay required for period 20 December 2026 to 10 January 2027. All rates are nett and are quoted in USD per room per night on double occupancy and includes breakfast, service charge and government taxes. Third person supplements and child supplements are also nett per person per night including breakfast, service charge, government taxes and extra bed where applicable. Adult USD 100 (Extra Bed + Breakfast) Children (05 years to 11.99) USD 30 (Extra Bed + Breakfast). A USD 20 reduction per room per night applies for all Single Occupancy reservations. | MEAL PLAN: All guests will have their breakfast in The Terrace Restaurant. Lunch can be pre-booked for USD 40 per person per day; Dinner USD 50 per person per day; All Inclusive USD 150 nett per person per day (all at the Terrace Restaurant). Children (5y – 11.99 yrs) 50% of the adult meal supplements. All meal supplements are inclusive of service charge and exclusive of beverages. | ALL INCLUSIVE OPTION – inclusions: curated breakfast selection, a refined three-course set menu, or à la carte dining for lunch and dinner at The Terrace Restaurant or in-room dining; selected premium & standard brands of imported spirits, unlimited selection of local branded spirits, beers, soft drinks & bottled water from 11.00 am to 11.00 pm; selected international sparkling wines and regular wines; minibar with beers, soft drinks and bottled water refilled daily; free daily sundown cocktail 04 p.m. – 07 p.m.; free farewell destination dinner; complimentary WIFI throughout the resort; complimentary Sauna and Steam room. All Inclusive supplement US $ 150 nett per person per day. Compulsory X'mas Eve Gala dinner supp. of US $ 100 per person payable on 24th December and New Year Eve Gala dinner supplement of US$ 145 per person on 31st Dec on top of the All-inclusive rate. Children (Age 5y to 11.99 yrs) 50% of the adult's all-inclusive supplements. "For All Inclusive bookings made 45 days prior to the arrival date for stays during the periods of 01.07.2026 to 31.10.2026 – All Inclusive supplement is US $ 130 nett per person per day." [not entered: the stay period printed ends 31 Oct 2026, before the rate table starts]. | TRANSFERS: Return Airport transfer via private car USD 330 nett including all taxes (Max. 02 people); One Way Airport transfer via private car USD 165 nett per transfer including all taxes (Max. 02 people). | CHECK IN/CHECK OUT: Check-in 2pm, check-out 12pm. Guaranteed early check-in can only be provided to rooms reserved 1 night prior to arrival. Late check-out is subject to availability and can only be guaranteed if an additional night is booked at the time of reservation. | RESERVATIONS: All reservations and cancellations must be confirmed to the resort by email (reservations@thefortress.lk). Special offers MUST be clearly marked on all rooming lists/requests/accommodation vouchers. | TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF AGREEMENT: all information and rates are strictly confidential; the rate contract does not constitute participation in any brochure or wholesale programme with fees; contract rates must not be quoted unpackaged or priced as nett nightly rates on any web page, brochure or leaflet; the Operator agrees to the cancellation policy; force majeure clause; the Operator indemnifies the Resort; the Resort may carry out repairs/renovations (prior notice of major prolonged work); the Resort must be informed in writing 30 days before any change of ownership or management. Valid when signed and returned by the Operator. Signed for The Fortress Resort and Spa by Shane Hallock, Chief Commercial Officer, Sri Lanka, 22nd Sept 2026. Resort: Koggala, Habaraduwa; [94] 91 438 9400; sales@thefortress.lk.
contract.notes: Transcribed from "Avenir Holidays.pdf" (4 pages), saved to the winter RTS folder on 2 Oct 2026. "Rate Contract – Avenir Holidays- 2026/2027, Issued on: 22nd Sept 2026 (Updated)", "Effective from 22nd Sept 2026 to 31st October 2027 (Winter 2026/27 & Summer 2027)". Validity entered as printed (22 Sep 2026 – 31 Oct 2027), but the rate table starts on 01.11.2026: there is no rate for 22 Sep – 31 Oct 2026 (W01; the lookup falls back to other plans for those nights). Bed & Breakfast, USD per room per night on double occupancy, nett incl. service charge and government taxes. SGL = DBL − USD 20 and TPL = DBL + third person adult USD 100 (extra bed + breakfast), except the Fortress Residence Suite (standard occupancy 04 adults, maximum 05 adults or 04 adults + 02 children) where TPL is left blank – confirm with the hotel how the suite rate scales beyond 2 adults. The rate table prints this period "20.12.2026 -10.01.2026" (end before start); entered as 20 Dec 2026 – 10 Jan 2027: the next period starts 11.01.2027 and the minimum-stay, cancellation and payment lines all say 20 December 2026 to 10 January 2027. HB / FB / AI are derived from the pre-bookable meals (dinner 50, lunch 40, all inclusive 150 per person per day; children 50%). Galas: 24 Dec BB 150 / HB-FB-AI 100 per adult, 31 Dec BB 195 / HB-FB-AI 145 (children 75 / 50 / 97.50 / 72.50). Minimum 4 nights 20 Dec 2026 – 10 Jan 2027 (season min_stay + restriction; the lookup does not enforce it – staff check). Festive bookings need 100% prepayment before 01 October – already past when the sheet was saved (2 Oct 2026). Cancellation entered for the printed 2026/27 high and festive periods; nothing is printed for May–Jun and Sep–Oct 2027 (the low-season row says 01 May 26 – 30 Jun 26 / 01 Sept 26 – 31 Oct 26 – probably last year's dates, not corrected). Room names: Ocean Room, Beach Room and Fortress Residence Suite match the hotel's existing types; "Courtyard Rooms", "Premium Ocean Room" and "Premium Beach Room" are new (the hotel already has "Fortress Room", "Beach Splash Room" and "Ocean Loft Suite", not on this contract) – check before saving that Courtyard Rooms is not the old "Fortress Room". No market restriction, guide policy or booking window printed.
